from zipfile import ZipFile
from decimal import Decimal, getcontext
getcontext().prec=80
class Node:
    __slots__=('children','parent','length','name')
    def __init__(self): self.children=[]; self.parent=None; self.length=Decimal(0); self.name=''
def parse(s):
    s=s.strip().rstrip(';'); i=0
    def rec():
        nonlocal i
        n=Node()
        if s[i]=='(':
            i+=1
            while True:
                c=rec(); c.parent=n; n.children.append(c)
                if s[i]==',': i+=1; continue
                assert s[i]==')'; i+=1; break
            st=i
            while i<len(s) and s[i] not in ',():;': i+=1
            n.name=s[st:i].strip()
        else:
            st=i
            while i<len(s) and s[i] not in ',():;': i+=1
            n.name=s[st:i].strip()
        if i<len(s) and s[i]==':':
            i+=1; st=i
            while i<len(s) and s[i] not in ',():;': i+=1
            n.length=Decimal(s[st:i])
        return n
    return rec()
def tree_mean(s):
    root=parse(s); leaves=[]
    def go(n):
        if not n.children: leaves.append(n)
        for c in n.children: go(c)
    go(root)
    def dist(a,b):
        aa={}; x=a; d=Decimal(0)
        while x is not None: aa[x]=d; d+=x.length; x=x.parent
        y=b; d2=Decimal(0)
        while y not in aa: d2+=y.length; y=y.parent
        return aa[y]+d2
    ds=[dist(leaves[i],leaves[j]) for i in range(len(leaves)) for j in range(i)]
    return sum(ds,Decimal(0))/Decimal(len(ds)), tuple(sorted(x.name for x in leaves)), ds

def rows(path):
  with ZipFile(path) as z:
    out=[]
    for p in z.namelist():
      if p.endswith('.treefile'):
       m,t,ds=tree_mean(z.read(p).decode())
       out.append((m,p,t,ds))
    return sorted(out)
A=rows('inputs/scogs_animals.zip');F=rows('inputs/scogs_fungi.zip')
def med(v):
 n=len(v)
 if n%2: return v[n//2][0], [v[n//2]]
 return (v[n//2-1][0]+v[n//2][0])/2, [v[n//2-1],v[n//2]]
ma,ca=med(A); mf,cf=med(F)
print('animal n',len(A),'median',ma)
for x in ca: print(' central A',x[1],x[0],x[2], 'pairs',x[3])
print('fungi n',len(F),'median',mf)
for x in cf: print(' central F',x[1],x[0],x[2], 'pairs',x[3])
print('ratio F/A',mf/ma)
print('ratio A/F',ma/mf)
print('repr ratio F/A',format(mf/ma,'f'))
PY"
